hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Protocol lending vaults. It intercepts all swaps via beforeSwap, deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and enforces a custom price curve invariant, bypassing Uniswap's native concentrated liquidity pool mechanics entirely.
